title: Layout Probe
prompt: Implement the four `probe` functions against the frozen `Record` struct: size, alignment, member offsets of `id` and `score`. The test checks them against the ABI facts this compiler produces — wrong probe logic (hardcoded guesses) fails on some platform by construction.

tests.name: probe equals the compiler's own ABI facts
tests.hint: Forward to the compiler: sizeof(Record), alignof(Record), offsetof(Record, member). Hardcoded numbers are exactly the ABI lie this module warns about.
